problem.title: SuMa shared translation remap on KITTI 08 full
problem.question: Does the existing DiLO 0.03 translation remap transfer to SuMa without tuning?

variants.label: SuMa raw paper path + shared local translation remap 0.03
variants.intent: Non-paper opt-in, default off. Fixed ratio transferred from the existing DiLO01 choice, without SuMa tuning;01 is a development case. Other parameters stay official/raw. Experimental evidence only, excluded from published leaderboard and paper-ratio promotion.
